title: Book One · Chapter 19: The Other Boy
story:
Ronan sees the red wheel before he sees the boy.

He is outside the bun shop with Dad. Dad is counting small change. A bicycle stops near the wall. There is a pale mark on the front wheel. Ronan knows that mark.

Then he sees the handlebar. His bell is not on it now.

A man holds the seat. Ronan knows him from the old shop. He bought the bike from Dad.

"Hello," the man says to Dad. "How are you settling in?"

"All right," Dad says. He puts a hand lightly on Ronan's back.

The boy on the bike gets off. His hair stands up at the front. He has a blue patch on one knee.

"This is my son, Bo," the man says. "I'm Mr Han. I don't think we told you our names."

Ronan looks at the bike. The chain is clean. Bo has tied a short white ribbon under the seat.

"That wasn't there," Ronan says.

Bo looks at the white ribbon. "My mum put it on. So we can see it with the other bikes."

"It was mine."

Bo looks at Mr Han. Mr Han doesn't pull the bike away.

"Yes," he says. "I bought it from your dad."

Dad's hand is still on Ronan's back. Ronan moves a little. The hand drops.

Bo looks down at the wheel.

"Did you make that mark?" he asks.

Ronan nods. "I hit a wall."

"Did the wall get a mark?"

"A big one."

Bo smiles. Ronan wants to stay angry. But he remembers the loud noise. His front wheel hit the wall hard. He starts to tell Bo about it.

Mr Han buys buns. Dad stands with him near the pot. Bo stays beside the bike.

"Does it turn fast?" Bo asks.

"You must turn slowly on loose stones."

"I fell last week."

"Did you hurt your knee?"

"This is an old patch. I fell on my other side."

He turns to show his other trouser leg. It is clean. Ronan almost laughs.

Bo touches the empty place on the handlebar. "Dad said you kept the bell."

"I did."

"I want a new one. With a low sound."

Ronan still wants the sound of his old bell. He runs a finger along the seat, then takes his hand away.

Bo asks, "How do you start? My pedal goes down too soon. I cannot get my foot on it. Can you show me?"

Ronan looks at Dad. Dad is watching, but he doesn't speak for him.

Ronan shows Bo with one hand. He doesn't get on the bike. Bo tries once while Mr Han holds the seat. Bo moves the pedal higher first. Now he can put his foot on it.

"Like that?"

"Yes."

Mr Han says they must go. Bo lifts his hand to Ronan. Then his father walks the bike away, with Bo beside it.

Dad gives Ronan the smaller bun. Ronan takes it but doesn't eat.

"Will he ever give it back?" he asks.

"No. It's his now."

"I know."

They stand by the shop for a while. Dad doesn't tell him to be happy for Bo. At last Ronan breaks his bun in half. The bread is hot inside. Ronan eats one half on the way home. He holds the other half in both hands. Dad walks beside him. Neither of them speaks for a while.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：bell＝铃；pedal＝脚踏板；patch＝补丁；chain＝链条。

辅助理解：handlebar＝自行车车把；patch在裤子上指补丁。

理解问题：

1. 红自行车现在属于谁？
2. Bo 提出的哪个请求让 Ronan 感到意外？
